Seven persons — P, Q, R, S, T, U and V — have lectures on different days of the same week, starting from Monday and ending on Sunday. Only one lecture is held on each day. Each of them teaches a different subject — Biology, Geography, Sanskrit, Chemistry, Maths, Economics and Hindi. Each of them is from a different city — Chennai, Ranchi, Mumbai, Patna, Pune, Agra and Nagpur.

1. The one who teaches Hindi is from Agra.
2. Only one person has a lecture between T and the one who is from Chennai.
3. As many persons have lectures before P as after S.
4. The one who is from Agra has a lecture before the one who teaches Chemistry.
5. Only three persons have lectures between the one who is from Agra and the one who is from Mumbai, and the one who is from Mumbai has a lecture before the one who is from Agra.
6. R teaches Biology.
7. U is from Mumbai.
8. At least one person has a lecture between U and the one who teaches Economics.
9. S is from Nagpur.
10. The one who teaches Maths is from Ranchi.
11. Only two persons have lectures between the one who teaches Geography and the one who teaches Chemistry.
12. As many persons have lectures before U as after R.
13. Q is from Pune.
14. Less than two persons have lectures between P and the one who teaches Chemistry.

Seven persons — J, K, L, M, N, O and P — have lectures on different days of the same week, starting from Monday and ending on Sunday. Only one lecture is held on each day. Each of them is from a different city — Nagpur, Pune, Jaipur, Kochi, Chennai, Delhi and Agra. Each of them teaches a different subject — Sanskrit, Hindi, History, Chemistry, Biology, English and Geography.

1. Only one person has a lecture between the one who is from Nagpur and the one who is from Pune, and the one who is from Nagpur has a lecture after the one who is from Pune.
2. Only five persons have lectures between the one who teaches History and the one who teaches Chemistry.
3. The one who is from Chennai has a lecture before J.
4. Neither the one who teaches English nor the one who teaches History has a lecture on Sunday.
5. Only one person has a lecture between K and the one who is from Kochi.
6. As many persons have lectures before J as after N.
7. N has a lecture immediately after the one who is from Delhi.
8. As many persons have lectures before K as after M.
9. More than two persons have lectures between M and L.
10. Only three persons have lectures between N and the one who is from Chennai, and N has a lecture after the one who is from Chennai.
11. P teaches Biology.
12. Only one person has a lecture between the one who teaches Sanskrit and the one who is from Pune.
13. The one who teaches Geography does not have a lecture immediately before the one who teaches Hindi.
14. Only five persons have lectures after the one who teaches English.
15. P is from Jaipur.

set.subject: reasoning
set.title: Scheduling puzzle
set.stimulus:
Eight persons — S, T, U, V, W, X, Y and Z — have lectures on four consecutive days of a week — Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday and Friday — in two sessions each day: morning and evening. Only one lecture is held in each session, and the morning session comes before the evening session. Each of them teaches a different subject — Physics, Accounts, Maths, Geography, Sanskrit, English, Economics and Biology. Each of them is from a different city — Chennai, Shimla, Pune, Mumbai, Agra, Delhi, Patna and Kolkata.

1. V teaches Maths.
2. The one who teaches Physics has a lecture on Wednesday.
3. Neither Z nor X has a lecture on Thursday.
4. The one who is from Chennai and Z have lectures on different days.
5. The one who teaches Physics does not have a lecture immediately after or immediately before W.
6. Only two persons have lectures between the one who is from Kolkata and the one who is from Shimla, and the one who is from Shimla has a lecture before the one who is from Kolkata.
7. Only two persons have lectures between the one who is from Kolkata and Y, and the one who is from Kolkata has a lecture after Y.
8. Neither the one who teaches Sanskrit nor S has a lecture on Thursday.
9. Only one person has a lecture between W and T.
10. Only two persons have lectures between X and S.
11. The one who is from Mumbai and the one who teaches Biology have lectures on the same day.
12. U is from Agra.
13. W teaches Economics.
14. S has a lecture before the one who is from Patna.
15. The one who teaches English is from Pune.
16. Only two persons have lectures between the one who teaches Accounts and the one who teaches Geography, and the one who teaches Accounts has a lecture after the one who teaches Geography.
17. The one who teaches Biology is from Patna.
18. Only four persons have lectures between the one who is from Pune and the one who is from Agra.
